boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Our box office opens at 5PM on show days.

venues.parkingDetail: We do not have our own parking lot, but there are several paid lots within walking distance, as well as street parking. Additionally, Brooklyn Bowl Nashville has partnered with ParkWhiz to offer other easy and reliable options at https://www.parkwhiz.com/brooklyn-bowl-nashville-parking/?utm_medium=LiveNation&utm_source=1269&utm_campaign=Email_LN_VenueLink to book parking.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: We are a standing room venue. However, we are ADA compliant and offer seating for guests with special needs. Please visit our accessibility page or check in with our event staff upon your arrival for more information.

generalInfo.generalRule: Prohibited Items: Guests, performers and employees are prohibited from bringing firearms, knives or other weapons into Brooklyn Bowl, as well as incendiary devices, laser pointers and any illegal items including drugs or drug paraphernalia. No alcoholic beverages or other outside food or drink, video cameras, GoPros, selfie sticks or professional cameras (removable lenses) are allowed. Costumes are allowed, but full face masks, fake weapons, and additional props are prohibited. We do not require clear bags. However we do not allow large bags or backpacks, and all bags will be searched.
generalInfo.childRule: Most of our shows are 18+ or 21+, but we will occasionally have "all ages" shows. For shows listed as 18+, minors will be allowed in with a parent or legal guardian only. Minors attending with siblings or older friends will not be permitted without proof of guardianship. All children over the age of 1 are required to have tickets to attend a show.

There is a 6 seat maximum per ticket order. Traveling to Nashville to catch a show with us? We recommend flying with Southwest Airlines®, the official airline partner of The Bluebird Cafe. Note: When making reservations, choose the table you would like and then add the number of seats you need to your cart by using the + button. You are NOT reserving an entire table if you choose 1 (by choosing 1, you are reserving 1 seat). We reserve ALL seats at each table. If you are a smaller party at a larger table, you will be seated with guests outside your party.
events.pleaseNote: ***Please note, when you make a reservation at The Bluebird Cafe, you are agreeing to the following terms & conditions: - Ticket reservations at The Bluebird Cafe are an agreement to pay the cover charge and applicable taxes/fees and to meet the $15.00 per seat food and/or drink minimum. - If you are a no show, we reserve the right to charge your credit card for the $15.00 minimum for each seat in your reservation. - Ticket reservations are for your personal use. They are NOT transferrable and NOT for resale! We perform random I.D. checks and the name on the reservation must match the name on the I.D. - Cancel at least 48 hours before showtime to receive a refund of the ticket price and tax (ticketing fees are non-refundable). Please call (615-383-1461) or email (info@bluebirdcafe.com) to cancel your reservation. - Attendees are expected to show up by the start of the show for which they have tickets. Seats that are unclaimed once the show has started will be seated from the walk-up line. - Performers are subject to change. - Bar seats are only for customers 21 years of age or older. - Any guest under the age of 18 must be seated with a parent or guardian. - We require accessible seat requests to be made two weeks in advance of the show date for guaranteed accessible seats. If you made a reservation outside of that window using our online system, please call The Bluebird Cafe during office hours and we will do our best to accommodate your needs. Please know that if you reserved outside of the two week window, accessible seats are not guaranteed. - The Bluebird Cafe is a listening room. If you do not honor our SHHHH! policy (being quiet while the performers are on stage) you may be asked to leave. - No outside food and/or drink is allowed inside the venue. - Still photography is allowed, unless the artist requests otherwise. - RECORDING COPYRIGHTED MATERIAL (VIDEO OR AUDIO) IS PROHIBITED. - We have a small lot directly in front of the cafe and a larger gravel lot behind the cafe. To access our gravel lot, please use the alley entrance on Hillsboro Pike next to United Community Bank. Please do not utilize our neighbors' parking lots, as they enforce towing and do NOT park at the bank unless after 4:30 PM. All guests must enter and check in through our main entrance on Hillsboro Pike. - For the safety and comfort of all our guests, Bluebird Cafe management has the right to refuse service to anyone who is aggressive, hostile or appears to be intoxicated.

events.name: Blisspop Presents: Hot In Herre: 2000s Dance Party
events.info: Hot In Herre: 2000s Dance Party2000s bangers only. Your favorite songs across every genre.Pop Hip-Hop Indie R Emo And everything in betweenHot In Herre brings all your favorite music of the Y2K era back to the dance floor. Dope DJs behind the decks and era-defining visuals will transport you to the days of away messages. blinged-out flip phones and trucker hats.Youll hear all the bangers from the first decade of the millennium. And we mean ALL. Were running through the entire almanac from Akon to Zombie Nation. Artists like Nelly, Britney Spears, Beyonc, Avril Lavigne, Katy Perry, Usher, Lady Gaga, Rihanna, Panic! At The Disco, Eminem, Black Eyed Peas, Jay-Z, Taylor Swift, Pitbull, Paramore, Missy Elliott, Miley Cyrus, Outkast, 50 Cent, Kesha, T-Pain, Flo Rida, Kelly Clarkson, Lil Jon, Justin Timberlake, Pink, Shakira, Sean Paul, The Killers, and so many more.Wear your best 2000s-era gear! Were talking fuzzy pink Juicy Couture sweats, stunner shades, Ed Hardy shirts, loooow-rise jeans, UGG boots, crop tops you name it, just wear it!Were taking song requests all night too. Dust off those old iPod playlists and have your faves ready to go.
